open.label: Ask for a recap of The Cartographer's Silence at 4:03:17, then say whether it helped

steps.say: Ask for a Standard recap of The Cartographer's Silence (cs-1) at 4:03:17, so the key Standard · 14597 exists on the book's catch-up stream. Until the host lands the JWT library the service refuses every bearer token by design (research R-2) and this step records 401; once it does, 404 until LB3's import has written a BookImported for this listener on book-cs-1, and 200 after that.

Thumbs up on the {tier} recap at 4:03:17. Until CU5 has generated a recap at that key the service answers 422 noRecapAtKey (R3) — there is nothing to rate yet; with one generated, 200 { bookId, tier, position, thumb: up, ratedAt } (CU8-1).
The same thumb again: answered exactly as the first was, with the standing thumb's own instant, and nothing new is recorded (R2, CU8-5).
A change of mind: thumbs down replaces the thumb that stood, and the fold now reads down (R2, CU8-4).
